# Candidate crystals
- Crystal-K1: inorganic scintillator, high light yield, fast decay.
- Crystal-K3: inorganic scintillator, medium light yield.
- Crystal-K2: inorganic scintillator, mature growth process, lower light yield.
All three are available in the required sizes from at least one vendor.

# Earlier simulation summary (2025, nominal 5 cm thickness)
Energy resolution at 662 keV (FWHM): Crystal-K1 2.9%, Crystal-K3 4.5%, Crystal-K2 8.5%.
Thickness dependence was weak in the 3-8 cm range.

# Radiopurity assay campaign, Q1 2026
Sample crystals of each candidate were counted for 30 days in the underground HPGe station.
Intrinsic background of the crystal, 100-3000 keV (counts/kg/day):
- Crystal-K1: 2.0 +- 0.2   (dominated by internal contamination of the crystal itself)
- Crystal-K3: 0.30 +- 0.05
- Crystal-K2: 0.10 +- 0.03
Facility background budget for the spectrometer crystal: 0.5 counts/kg/day.
Contact: radiopurity working group.

# Meeting notes 2026-02-11
Attendees discussed the shielding upgrade (lead + copper, complete) and the schedule for commissioning in Q3. Action: finalise the crystal choice this quarter.

# Shielding status
The 20 cm lead + 5 cm OFHC copper castle is installed. Radon purge with boil-off nitrogen is operational.

content.text: K1 has the best resolution in the 2025 summary, but its intrinsic background (2.0 counts/kg/day) is four times the 0.5 budget. K3 (0.30) and K2 (0.10) fit the budget. I'll check the simulation across thicknesses and read the remaining documents.

# Schedule
Q2: crystal procurement. Q3: assembly and commissioning. Q4: first assays.

# DAQ readout plan
The PMT signal is digitised at 250 MS/s with 14-bit ADCs. Firmware supports pulse-shape discrimination. No change is needed for any crystal candidate.

content.text: The 5 cm results match the 2025 summary. Next I'll check whether K3 resolution changes with thickness.

input.justification: Crystal-K1 gives the best simulated resolution (2.88% FWHM at 5 cm), but its measured intrinsic background is 2.0 counts/kg/day, four times the facility budget of 0.5 counts/kg/day, so it is unsuitable for low-background operation. Crystal-K2 meets the background budget (0.10) but its resolution is about 8.5% FWHM. Crystal-K3 meets the budget (0.30 +- 0.05 counts/kg/day) and gives the best resolution among compliant options: 4.78% FWHM at 5 cm. Thickness scan for K3: 2 cm 5.33%, 3 cm 4.88%, 5 cm 4.78%, 8 cm 5.14%, 10 cm 6.45%, so 5 cm is near the optimum. The 5 cm choice is within the 2-10 cm limit.
